_about: Traitor in the party: secret roles handed out by the script, public evidence. Designed by us. Story axes for story_gen.py. Each axis is rolled on its own; an entry is a string (weight 1) or {v, w, decay}. All text is our own.

traitor_goal: delay the party until a deadline
make the party turn on each other
cover: an obvious decoy who is innocent
tell: is never there when things go wrong
a habit from the other side
channel: notes left in a hollow tree
reveal_trigger: the traitor must act openly to win
a fellow party member confesses for them

cliches: the traitor has a twirling moustache
an evil laugh at the reveal
